body:
Spot UV greeting cards use 300gsm coated stock with a matte lamination base, then add a glossy UV coating to selected areas — a logo, a pattern, or a greeting — creating a matte-versus-gloss contrast that makes key elements pop. The eye goes straight to the raised, shiny detail.

Christmas, New Year, and thank-you cards become more expressive when a snowflake, a name, or a heart is lifted in gloss against a soft matte field. Branded corporate cards use the same trick to make logos feel dimensional and expensive, turning an ordinary mailer into a piece worth keeping.

The contrast technique also flatters photography and line art: light catching the coated areas adds depth that flat printing cannot deliver. It is an ideal middle ground for brands that want something more tactile than plain matte but more restrained than full metallic foil.

Cards are printed on 300g coated or synthetic paper with 4-color offset plus spot UV, applying a 20-30 micron dimensional gloss to the highlighted areas. ICC color management keeps brand colors stable across the batch, and finishing options include matte or gloss lamination and rounded-corner die-cutting, with a free die-cut check before production.

Pricing is HK$140-260 per 100 cards, with a 100-card minimum order. Your order includes a free design check and free sample; paper is FSC certified and production follows ISO 9001 quality control. Cards ship direct from our Asia factory via DHL Express in 2-4 days worldwide to 50+ countries, and a 30-second AI quote with no setup fees gets you started.

**FAQ**

**Q1: How does spot UV change the look?** Glossy UV coating is applied to selected areas, creating a striking contrast against the matte base.

**Q2: Which parts of the design get the UV coating?** Whatever you choose — logos, patterns, or greeting text are the most common choices.

**Q3: Can I request a sample first?** Yes, a free sample and design check are included with your order.

Ready to make it pop? Get a free digital proof within 1 hour — WhatsApp +86 198 8085 1334 or click the "30-second AI quote" button on the page.
